title: The Latest Crier for Nov 12, 2026
items:
There's still time to apply to be an RA!

Are you interested in gaining leadership skills, helping others, meeting new people, and having your own room? Then click here to join the res life team! Please note that you need to logged into Handshake in order to view the job listing . Benefits include a partial room waiver, a double-as-a-single room at no extra charge, and a flexible work schedule. See your RA or area coordinator if you have questions!

FALL-ing into Rhythm- New location In the Atrium

Please join Central Sounds for FALL-inf into Rhythm, Saturday, Nov14 from 2-4pm with some of favorite Indie/Folk songs: 
American Cars-Noah Kahan, Over Country- Lizzy McApline, Linger -The Cranberries, Dashboard-Noah Kahan, Home - Phillip Phillips and many more from Noah Kahan, Olivia Rodrigo, Taylor Swift, Lord Huron and others! 

Plus Hot Cider and mini Pumpkin Decorting!
